info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Quality Assurance Assessments API
info.description: The Product Quality Assurance Assessments API enables businesses to initiate and manage quality assessments for banking products. By facilitating the submission of assessment data, this API allows financial institutions to ensure their offerings meet established standards of quality and compliance. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and compliance officers who utilize it to maintain the integrity of their product lines. This API is essential for improving customer satisfaction and regulatory adherence in the banking sector.

post.summary: Create a new quality assessment for a product.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a quality assessment for a specific product, enabling the evaluation of its quality metrics and compliance with standards. It is essential for ensuring that products meet quality expectations before reaching the market.
